title: Seshadri slope $\K$-semistability for the blow-up of projective space along a linear subspace
summary: We study a particular instance of the frame work from \cite{Grieve:CM:Line:Slope:Stab}, building on earlier work of Arezzo-et-al \cite{Arezzo:DellaVedova:LaNave}, Ross and Thomas \cite{Ross:Thomas:2007}, \cite{Ross:Thomas:2006} and others, which applies the theory of the Chow-Mumford line bundle to determine the Donaldson-Futaki invariant of deformation to the normal cone test configurations with respect to big and nef line bundles.
